falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 closes above 5,600 on any day in the next 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The 77% pattern match to bottom_2024_aug would be broken, as that bottom formation required lower highs and a retest structure; a breakout above pre-correction levels invalidates the bottoming thesis and suggests the 'UNKNOWN' verdict was masking a continuation rally, not a bottoming process

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes below 12.50 for 3 consecutive trading days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A sustained VIX compression below the August 2024 low-volatility regime threshold would falsify the bottom pattern match, as that bottom featured VIX spikes to 38-65; this would indicate complacency inconsistent with capitulation/bottom formation, proving the signal was misidentifying a consolidation as a bottom

falsification_conditions.condition: 10Y Treasury yield drops more than 40 basis points from current level within 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A flight-to-quality rally of that magnitude without equity market collapse would invalidate the macro bottom call, as the August 2024 bottom saw yields rise with equities (reflation trade); divergent bond rally suggests recession panic rather than soft-landing bottom, breaking the pattern correlation

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
